#include <iostream>
#include <gmpxx.h>

int main() {
    mpz_class MOD("998244353");
    long n, m, L, R;
    std::cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;

    long total = R - L + 1;

    if ((n * m) % 2 != 0) {
        mpz_class power = n * m;
        mpz_class baseVal = total;
        mpz_class result;
        mpz_powm(result.get_mpz_t(), baseVal.get_mpz_t(), power.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());
        std::cout << result.get_str() << std::endl;
    } else {
        long evenCount = R / 2 - (L - 1) / 2;
        long oddCount = total - evenCount;
        mpz_class E(evenCount);
        mpz_class O(oddCount);
        mpz_class exponent = n * m;

        mpz_class sumVal, diffVal, temp;
        mpz_powm(sumVal.get_mpz_t(), (E + O).get_mpz_t(), exponent.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());
        mpz_powm(diffVal.get_mpz_t(), (E - O).get_mpz_t(), exponent.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t());

        mpz_class numerator = (sumVal + diffVal) % MOD;
        mpz_class denominator = 2;
        mpz_class inv_two;
        mpz_invert(inv_two.get_mpz_t(), denominator.get_mpz_t(), MOD.get_mpz_t()); // modular inverse of 2 mod MOD
        mpz_class result = (numerator * inv_two) % MOD;

        std::cout << result.get_str() << std::endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
